# AI QA Framework — Handbook

How a human works with this repository. The AI's rules are in CLAUDE.md and the skills; this file explains the why and the daily routine.

## Principles
- **The repo is the only source of knowledge.** Rules, skills, templates, lessons and project knowledge live in files; chat is never the source of truth.
- **One kind of knowledge = one source file** (map in .claude/skills/kb-update/SKILL.md). manager/GUIDE.md is generated from those files.
- **Every artifact is reviewed.** Gap Report, viewpoints and test cases go DRAFT → human review → LOCKED. A LOCKED file changes only through a new revision.
- **The AI never guesses.** No spec path → BLOCKED_INPUT. Unclear spec → Open Question. Message text → spec/messages.md or [to confirm].
- **Every fixed mistake becomes a lesson** that the AI reads before the next task (qc/lessons for design, automation/lessons for code).
- **Automation reads only LOCKED test cases.** Code is generated from them, so test cases and code cannot drift silently.

## Setup
1. Install [Claude Code](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/overview) and open the repository folder.
2. Node.js 20+ and Python 3 (for build_guide.py).
3. Enable the commit hook once: `git config core.hooksPath .githooks` (checks GUIDE.md and runs the public-safety scan).
4. For the demo automation: see examples/demo-shop/automation/web/README.md.

## Adding a project
1. Create `examples/<project>/` (or any folder) with README.md (roles, OS, ID conventions, result columns), sources.md (source priority), glossary.md, bug-history.md, screens/_flow.md, screens/catalog/, spec/, raw/ (gitignored originals), qc/.
2. Point CLAUDE.md at it: `Active project: <name> → <P> = <folder>`.
3. Copy examples/demo-shop/automation/web as a starting point; replace env/, data/roles.ts, screens/ and scripts/step-patterns.mjs.

## Daily flow for one ticket
| Step | You say | The AI does | You do |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | "import spec <file>" | source-import: xlsx / pdf / docx → spec/<scope-key>.md, row reconciliation, list of lost content | Check the lost-content list |
| 1 | "/spec-review <P>/spec/<scope-key>.md" | Reads spec + knowledge + lessons, writes Gap Report, Findings, OQs, Design Gate, Context pack | Answer OQs, approve → LOCKED → "Done" |
| 2 | "/test-viewpoint <scope-key>" | Viewpoints by the 8 groups, each with an axis, traced to the spec | Review merges / axes → LOCKED |
| 3 | "/test-case <scope-key>" | One TC per axis value, 1 expected result each, Automation Eligibility, 3-source reconciliation, VP ↔ TC trace | Review → LOCKED; export Excel if needed |
| 4 | "generate specs for <scope-key> and run them" | `npm run gen`, recon for new screens, `npm test`, reads FAIL.md | Approve proposed lessons; route PRODUCT_BUG / wrong TC to QC |

## The lessons loop
1. A test fails or a reviewer finds a missed case.
2. The AI classifies it: LOCATOR / TIMING / DATA / ENV (automation) · DESIGN_GAP (QC) · PRODUCT_BUG (bug-history) · wrong TC (new TC revision).
3. The AI drafts the lesson (symptom, root cause, fix, rule) in chat; you approve.
4. The lesson file is written, the rule goes into the INDEX, decisions / CHANGELOG are updated, GUIDE.md is regenerated.
5. Next time the AI reads the INDEX before designing or coding, so the same mistake does not repeat.

## Known bugs in automation
A TC that fails because of a confirmed product bug keeps its expected result. The bug goes into bug-history.md with status Open, the TC Function names the bug ID, and the generator marks the test as an expected failure. Reports list it under "Known bugs"; when the bug is fixed the test passes unexpectedly and CI turns red, which is the signal to close the bug and regenerate.

## Reports
Each run writes reports/Runs/<run>/SUMMARY.md (totals, failed step per TC, known bugs), reports/Failed/<TC>/FAIL.md (one field per row, screenshot, video, trace), reports/HISTORY.md (trend) and reports/PERFORMANCE.md (slow APIs, never a failure). `npm run summary` prints the latest summary, `npm run report` opens Playwright's HTML report.

## Changing the rules
Say what should change ("from now on…", "add a rule…"). kb-update picks the one source file, drafts before / after, and after approval writes the file, a decision row, a CHANGELOG line and regenerates GUIDE.md. Release: "release" → version bump + dated CHANGELOG section.

## Publishing safely
Before pushing to a public remote run `bash scripts/check-before-push.sh`. It scans tracked files and history for `.env`, session files, videos, reports, token / password patterns and client words. Client words are kept in a local, gitignored `.client-words` file (one regex per line) so the list itself is never published.

#### `CLAUDE.md`

~~~~markdown
# AI QA Framework — Rules for the AI

## Context
- Built for Japanese-market products: the UI is in Japanese, the team works in English (or the team's own language).
- Viewpoints and test cases are written in ENGLISH. UI labels / messages keep their original text inside '' (never translate them).
- Active project: demo-shop → <P> = examples/demo-shop. Project profile: <P>/README.md, source priority: <P>/sources.md.
- Questions about the project (roles, screens, terms, flows, bugs…): read / grep in <P>/ (README.md, glossary.md, screens/_flow.md, screens/catalog/, bug-history.md, spec/) and answer with the source — no need to ask first. Say "I don't know" only after searching <P>/.

## Reading order when designing tests (mandatory)
0. Spec is xlsx / pdf / docx → skill source-import (original in <P>/raw/, Markdown in <P>/spec/)
1. Spec: <P>/spec/<scope-key>.md (the exact path the user gives)
2. Knowledge: <P>/README.md, <P>/sources.md, <P>/glossary.md, <P>/screens/_flow.md + related screens, LOCKED files in <P>/qc/ for the related function
3. Lessons: qc/lessons/INDEX.md (Test design section), <P>/bug-history.md (only rows with the same function / pattern)
4. Q&A: skill spec-review → Gap Report + Context pack + Open Questions. No OPEN OQ left + user confirms → [Done] → kb-update writes the knowledge into <P>/
5. Viewpoints: skill test-viewpoint (Context pack first, then knowledge + lessons of that function / screen)
6. Test cases: skill test-case (LOCKED viewpoints + Context pack + knowledge + lessons of that function)
   Every message in '' in Expected Results must be looked up in <P>/spec/messages.md (exact text or ID); missing / different → write [to confirm], never guess.
Reading / writing Excel: qc/lessons/INDEX.md section Excel / tools.

## Automation (separate flow: Spec → Test case → Automation)
- Only input: LOCKED test cases in <P>/qc/test-cases/ with Automation Eligibility UI-AUTO / BOTH. Do not read the spec, Gap Report, viewpoints, qc/lessons or bug-history (exception: the generator reads bug-history.md only to mark known bugs).
- Also read: automation/lessons/INDEX.md, <P>/automation/README.md, <P>/automation/web/README.md (TC → code conventions), <P>/automation/web/screens/ for the related screens; screen descriptions live in <P>/screens/catalog/.
- TC missing / contradicting the app → stop and tell the user; never edit the TC, never change an expect to match the app.
- Automation knowledge is updated with skill kb-update-automation (not kb-update).
- Login in tests: ONLY through <P>/automation/web/common/session.ts (loginAs(page, 'standard'), logout). Never write a login helper, never put login IDs / passwords in a spec. Accounts: env/<ENV>.json › accounts + .env.
- Messages used in expects must match <P>/spec/messages.md; not in the file → note the source (LOCKED TC / real app) and tell the user.
- New / never-run screen: MUST inspect the real screen before writing locators (R01) — `npm run recon` or the browser. Recon output goes only to the temporary folder reports/_tmp_chk/recon/ (overwritten each run); what must be kept goes to screens/ (locators) and automation/lessons/ (lessons). Cite the source as 'recon <date>, <env>', never a reports/ path.
- Generated specs are edited ONLY through the generator (scripts/gen-specs.mjs + scripts/step-patterns.mjs). After regenerating, review the git diff (R42).
- Writing / fixing test code: read automation/lessons/INDEX.md FIRST; locators live only in screens/. After fixing a failing test → always propose a lesson (draft: type, root cause, rule) for the user to approve, then write it to automation/lessons/ + INDEX; failures caused by a wrong TC → QC lesson (qc/lessons).

## Skills in this repo
- Test design: source-import, spec-review, test-viewpoint, test-case, export-excel (only when the user agrees); knowledge changes: kb-update.
- Each step (Gap Report, viewpoints, test cases) is: draft → user review → LOCKED. Never skip the review.

## Saving tokens
- During QC tasks do NOT read manager/ (GUIDE.md, handbook.md, decisions.md, CHANGELOG.md). Read them only when the user asks about decisions / history / guides.
- Read only the relevant part of a file (grep by function / ID), never a whole folder.

## General QC rules
- These rules apply only to QC tasks (viewpoint / test case design, automation). Other questions, lookups and repo changes requested by the user: work normally.
- When designing tests: the only input is the spec whose exact path the user gives. Missing → stop and return BLOCKED_INPUT. (Does NOT apply to lookup questions.)
- Never invent requirements. Unclear spec → write an Open Question in <P>/qc/open-questions.md.
- Draft in chat first, wait for approval of both content and path before writing files. Silence is not approval.
- Never edit a file with State = LOCKED. A change needs a new Revision and a new review.
- IDs: OQ-<CODE>-NNN · viewpoint <PREFIX>-NN · test case <PREFIX>-TC-NNN (PREFIX = sheet prefix; project conventions in <P>/README.md).
- Conflicting sources → follow the priority in <P>/sources.md; the permission matrix of the authoritative source overrides anything inferred from the UI.
- One sheet / function per task, exactly as requested; never widen the scope. Create new viewpoints only when asked.
- Deliverables for reviewers: export a new file, never edit the original.
- Every file the AI writes to <P>/qc/test-viewpoints/, test-cases/, gap-reports/ starts with the header: Project · Scope Key · Sheet prefix / Source (path + rev) / State (DRAFT | LOCKED) · Revision / Approved by / at.

## Knowledge
- Every change to rules, skills, templates, lessons or process → skill kb-update (edit exactly 1 source file, log decision + CHANGELOG, run manager/scripts/build_guide.py).
- manager/GUIDE.md is generated. Never edit it by hand.
~~~~

#### `.claude/skills/export-excel/SKILL.md`

~~~~markdown
---
name: export-excel
description: Export LOCKED viewpoints + test cases to a new Excel file in reports/ using the project's workbook format. Run only when the user asks or agrees ("export excel", "/export-excel", or answers "Yes" when the test-case skill asks).
---
# When to run
- Only when the user asks, or answers "Yes" to the last question of skill test-case: "Test cases are LOCKED. Export to Excel?". Never export on your own.

# Input
- <P>/qc/test-viewpoints/<scope-key>-viewpoints.md and <P>/qc/test-cases/<scope-key>-test-cases.md, both State = LOCKED. Not LOCKED → stop.
- Result columns per role / platform: <P>/README.md (section result columns). Only the roles / OS in scope (Gap Report).
- Excel lessons: qc/lessons/INDEX.md section Excel / tools (T01–T07).

# Output
- A NEW file: reports/<scope-key>-<YYYYMMDD>.xlsx. Never open / edit the project's original workbook (T07). Name exists → add -v2, -v3.
- Sheet 1 `<PREFIX>_Viewpoint`: the 9 columns of qc/templates/viewpoint.md.
- Sheet 2 `<PREFIX>`: the 12 TC columns (TC ID · Viewpoint ID · Test Level · Main Screen · Function · Pre-condition · Steps · Expected Results · Role · OS · Priority · Status). Do NOT export Automation Eligibility (repo-internal only).
- After the 12 columns: result columns per role / platform (empty for testers; values Passed / Failed / Fixed / Pending / N/A).
- Sheet names ≤ 31 characters (T01). Text starting with "=" is written as text (T05). Steps with line breaks inside the cell, wrap text, freeze the header row.

# Process
1. Check both files are LOCKED, count VPs / TCs.
2. Build the workbook with openpyxl (or the xlsx skill if available).
3. Reconcile: VP / TC rows in Excel = rows in md; every Viewpoint ID in the TC sheet exists in the Viewpoint sheet (except valid empty cells).
4. Report: file path, table Sheet | Rows | Match?.

# Forbidden
- Editing the md files / original workbook · adding or reordering columns · pre-filling test results.
~~~~

#### `.claude/skills/kb-update-automation/SKILL.md`

~~~~markdown
---
name: kb-update-automation
description: Update the AUTOMATION knowledge (locator / timing / data / env lessons, screen descriptions for automation, automation templates, test-code rules). Use when an automation failure has a known root cause, when a locator / Page Object changes, or when the user says "record automation lesson", "update automation knowledge", "/kb-update-automation".
---
# Principles
- Automation relies only on LOCKED test cases. Automation knowledge is separate from QC knowledge: this skill never edits the spec, Gap Report, viewpoints, test cases, qc/lessons, glossary or <P>/screens/ (business screens).

# Automation knowledge map — each kind has 1 source file
| Kind | Source file |
|---|---|
| Learned rules (shared) | automation/lessons/INDEX.md (Web R.., Mobile M..) |
| Detailed lesson | automation/lessons/<web\|mobile>/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<slug>.md per manager/templates/lesson.md |
| Automation templates | automation/templates/*.md |
| Screens for automation (screen ID, route, role, locators, actions) | <P>/automation/web/screens/<app>/<screen>.screen.ts per automation/templates/screen.md. Do NOT copy the screen description: it lives in <P>/screens/catalog/ |
| Environments, role ↔ account, test data | <P>/automation/web/env/*.json · data/roles.ts · data/<scope-key>.json (passwords only in .env) |
| Shared code (login, waits, asserts) | <P>/automation/web/common/ |
| Step → code patterns of the generator | <P>/automation/web/scripts/step-patterns.mjs |
| Notes on environments / data / test accounts (no passwords) | <P>/automation/README.md |
| Rules for writing test code | CLAUDE.md section Automation |

# Classifying a failure
| Lesson type | Who handles it | File |
|---|---|---|
| LOCATOR · TIMING · DATA | This skill | lesson + <P>/automation/web/screens/ or common/ |
| ENV | This skill (note only, no code change) | <P>/automation/README.md |
| PRODUCT_BUG | Do NOT change the test. Draft the bug → hand over to kb-update (QC) for <P>/bug-history.md; the generator then marks the TC as a known failure (test.fail + bug ID) | — |
| TC wrong / missing / contradicts the app | Do NOT edit the TC. Tell the user → QC fixes the TC (new revision) through test-case / kb-update | — |

# Process
1. Classify with the table above. Not automation → stop, point to the right skill.
2. Draft the change (before / after) in chat → wait for approval.
3. Edit the source file. Write a lesson for LOCATOR / TIMING / DATA.
4. The same lesson type happens 2+ times → propose 1 rule for automation/lessons/INDEX.md.
5. A change to automation rules / way of working → add 1 row to manager/decisions.md; always add 1 line to manager/CHANGELOG.md (tag [auto]).
6. Run python3 manager/scripts/build_guide.py. Report changed files + commit "[auto] <summary>".

# Forbidden
- Changing an expect to match the app when the TC says otherwise · editing files in <P>/qc/ · writing passwords / tokens into the repo · editing manager/GUIDE.md by hand.
~~~~

~~~~markdown
---
name: kb-update

| Kind | Source file |
|---|---|

| How each step works | .claude/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md (+ references/) |

| Why a decision was made | manager/decisions.md (1 row per decision) |
| Combined guide | manager/GUIDE.md — GENERATED, never edit by hand |

# Scope
- Do not edit automation knowledge (automation/, <P>/automation/, test-code rules) → use kb-update-automation.
- Hand-offs from kb-update-automation: PRODUCT_BUG → <P>/bug-history.md; wrong TC → propose a TC revision.

# Process
0. Common trigger: a Gap Report moves to [Done] (spec-review step 10) → only edit knowledge in <P>/, no decision / handbook needed.
1. Decide which kind the change is → pick the right source file. Never copy skill / template content into another file.
2. Draft the change (before / after) in chat → wait for approval.
3. Edit the source file.
4. A change to a rule or the way of working → add 1 row at the top of manager/decisions.md (next ID Dnn).
5. Add 1 line to manager/CHANGELOG.md, section [Unreleased], group Added / Changed / Removed, with the Dnn ID if any.
6. The change affects how humans read the repo → update the narrative in manager/handbook.md.
7. Run: python3 manager/scripts/build_guide.py
8. Report: list of changed files + suggested commit message "[kb] <summary>".

# Release
- The user says "release": rename [Unreleased] to [x.y.z] - YYYY-MM-DD, bump manager/VERSION (rule / skill behaviour change → y; wording → z), re-run build_guide.py.

# Forbidden
- Editing manager/GUIDE.md by hand · skipping the CHANGELOG · editing LOCKED files in qc/ · writing the same content into 2 source files.
~~~~

#### `.claude/skills/source-import/SKILL.md`

~~~~markdown
---
name: source-import
description: Convert client source documents (xlsx, csv, docx, pdf) to Markdown as input for test design. Originals stay in <P>/raw/, Markdown goes to <P>/spec/. Use when the user says "import spec", "convert excel to md", "add this excel to spec", "/source-import", or gives an .xlsx file as a spec.
---
# Input
- Original file in <P>/raw/ (the user gives the path). Not in raw/ yet → propose moving it there first. raw/*.xlsx|pdf|csv are gitignored: never commit confidential client documents.
- scope-key confirmed by the user.

# Process
1. List sheets / pages: name, number of data rows, whether they contain images / colours / comments / merged cells / formulas. Ask which sheets to import (default: every sheet with data).
2. Each sheet → 1 Markdown table. Find the header by its literal text (T03), never hard-code the row. Merged cells → repeat the value in every cell (T04). Formulas → take the computed value; cells that are "=..." text stay as text (T05). Japanese stays as is, never translated.
3. Write:
   - 1 file: <P>/spec/<scope-key>.md (main spec) or <P>/spec/<scope-key>/<sheet>.md when there are several large sheets.
   - At the top of each file: `<!-- Source: <P>/raw/<file> · Sheet: … · Imported: YYYY-MM-DD · Original revision: … -->`
4. Reconcile: table Sheet | Rows in original | Rows in md | Match?. Any mismatch → fix before reporting done.
5. Report what was LOST in the conversion (images, meaningful cell colours, comments, hyperlinks, data validation / dropdowns) with cell positions. Colours / comments that carry business meaning → copy them as text into an "Import note" column.
6. New source → propose 1 row for <P>/sources.md (the user decides the priority).

# Forbidden
- Editing the original in raw/ · summarising / dropping rows · translating Japanese · inferring the content of images.
~~~~

#### `.claude/skills/spec-review/SKILL.md`

~~~~markdown
---
name: spec-review
description: Q&A step before test design - read the spec, the project knowledge and the lessons, then find gaps, log Open Questions, decide the Design Gate and write a Context pack for the viewpoint / test case steps. Use when the user says "review spec", "find gaps", "spec Q&A", "/spec-review".
---
# Input
- <P> = active project (CLAUDE.md). Exact spec path <P>/spec/<scope-key>.md + approval status / revision. Missing → stop, return BLOCKED_INPUT. Spec only exists as xlsx / pdf → run skill source-import first.

# Process (in this order)
1. Read the spec. Propose scope-key (= spec file name), sheet prefix and OQ code. Wait for confirmation.
2. Read knowledge (relevant parts only, grep by function / screen):
   - <P>/README.md, <P>/sources.md (which source is authoritative)
   - <P>/glossary.md, <P>/screens/_flow.md + related screens (permission matrix, state transitions)
   - <P>/qc/test-viewpoints/, test-cases/ LOCKED files of the related function
3. Read lessons: qc/lessons/INDEX.md section "Test design"; <P>/bug-history.md only rows with the same function / field type / pattern.
4. Check scope: which roles the ticket covers, which release phase, parent / child tickets (lesson D11).
5. Q&A: list the test items (function, input, trigger, observable result, rule / data). For each item check: missing · ambiguous · conflicting sources · not verifiable · repeats a pattern that caused bugs → FND-<CODE>-NNN. Conflict → record which source wins per sources.md. Anything a human must decide → OQ-<CODE>-NNN in <P>/qc/open-questions.md (Status: OPEN).
6. Decide the Design Gate: READY · PARTIAL (state exactly what is blocked) · STOP.
7. Write the Context pack at the end of the Gap Report (date + revision of qc/lessons/INDEX.md), one sentence per row, with the source:
   | Type (Term / Screen / Permission / Old VP-TC / Lesson / Bug / Scope) | Source (file#section or ID) | Short content |
8. Follow qc/templates/gap-report.md exactly. Draft in chat → wait for approval → write <P>/qc/gap-reports/<scope-key>-gap-report.md (State: DRAFT); user approves → LOCKED.
9. Move to [Done] when all 3 hold: Gap Report LOCKED · every OQ of the scope in <P>/qc/open-questions.md is ANSWERED / RESOLVED (none OPEN) · the user confirms "Done". One condition missing → keep LOCKED and list the OPEN OQs.
10. On [Done]: call kb-update to update the project knowledge — only facts that are certain (approved spec + OQ answers):
    | Type | Target file |
    |---|---|
    | New term | <P>/glossary.md |
    | Screen, permission, state transition | <P>/screens/ |
    | Business rule, convention shared by many tickets | <P>/README.md |
    | New source document | <P>/sources.md |
    Draft a before/after table → user approves → write. Then: OQs moved into knowledge → RESOLVED; list the updated files in section 7 of the Gap Report.

# Forbidden
- Updating project knowledge before the Gap Report is [Done] · writing something true for only one ticket into shared project knowledge.
- Editing the spec · answering OQs yourself · treating silence as approval · reading whole folders instead of the relevant part.
~~~~

#### `.claude/skills/test-case/SKILL.md`

~~~~markdown
---
name: test-case
description: Generate test cases from LOCKED viewpoints in the TC sheet format (TC ID, Viewpoint ID, Test Level, Main Screen, Function, Pre-condition, Steps, Expected Results, Role, OS, Priority, Status) plus Automation Eligibility, then reconcile against 3 sources. Use when the user says "write test cases", "generate TC", "/test-case".
---
# Input
- <P>/qc/test-viewpoints/<scope-key>-viewpoints.md with State = LOCKED. Not LOCKED → stop.
- Context pack in <P>/qc/gap-reports/<scope-key>-gap-report.md (read first).
- Knowledge + lessons (selective reading, grep by function / screen, never whole folders):
  | Read | Why |
  |---|---|
  | qc/lessons/INDEX.md section Test design | Cases that are often missed (month end, double submit…) |
  | <P>/bug-history.md — rows of the same function | Every bug with "Caught by a TC" = No → at least 1 TC, Priority High |
  | <P>/screens/ — related screens | Steps follow the real flow, permission per role, exact Japanese labels |
  | <P>/glossary.md | Correct labels / messages in '' |
  | <P>/qc/test-cases/ LOCKED files of the same function + old TCs per sources.md | 3-source reconciliation, no duplicates |
  | <P>/README.md sections roles / OS / ID conventions | Correct Role, OS, TC ID for the project |
- qc/templates/testcase.md, qc/templates/data-test.md, references/test-design-techniques.md, references/automation-eligibility.md.
- Only the one requested sheet.

# Process
1. For each VP: read the "Axis" in Note; each value on the axis → 1 TC. Pick the technique (EP, BVA, Decision Table…). Many TCs with the same Viewpoint ID is correct.
2. TC ID = <PREFIX>-TC-NNN (CR / enhancement conventions in <P>/README.md). Written in English, Japanese labels kept inside ''.
3. 1 TC = 1 behaviour = 1 Expected Result.
   - Never combine several results in one cell (no "and", no 1) 2) 3) lists, no "<br>" with several results).
   - Several things to check (message + field colour + not saved to DB…) → one TC each, same Viewpoint ID, same Steps.
4. No pre-condition → "-". Steps numbered "1. … 2. …", step 1 is usually "Login as <Role>". Role / OS per spec.
5. Priority: High (main flow, UAT) · Medium (negative / main validation) · Low (UI, rare). Group 8 VPs (lessons / past bugs) → High, put the bug ID in Function or the note. Leave Status empty.
6. Set Automation Eligibility per automation-eligibility.md.
7. Reconcile 3 sources before calling it done: (1) viewpoints, (2) old TCs of the function (if sources.md lists them), (3) basic design. Missing cases → add them; an added TC that maps to no viewpoint → LEAVE Viewpoint ID EMPTY and list it separately so a human decides whether to create a VP. Conflicts → per sources.md.
8. Check duplicates by CONTENT (not only by ID) and trace both ways: print a table Viewpoint ID | Technique | TC count; a VP with 0 TCs needs a reason; a TC pointing to a non-existent VP is an error.
9. Draft → review → write <P>/qc/test-cases/<scope-key>-test-cases.md per qc/templates/testcase.md → lock when approved.
10. After LOCKED: ask exactly one question "Test cases are LOCKED. Export to Excel?". Yes → skill export-excel. No → stop.

# Forbidden
- Combining several expected results / scenarios in one TC · fake Viewpoint IDs (e.g. CHK-NEW) · creating viewpoints yourself.
- Renaming / reordering columns · using MANUAL to hide a spec gap (use NEEDS_SPEC) · inventing fields / messages · inferring permissions from the UI instead of the permission matrix.
~~~~

#### `.claude/skills/test-case/references/automation-eligibility.md`

~~~~markdown
| Value | Use when | Next |
|---|---|---|
| UI-AUTO | The result can be checked reliably by UI automation | Playwright / Appium |
| API-AUTO | Method, endpoint, auth, payload and response are all known | Later |
| BOTH | The same goal can be checked through the UI and the API | Playwright first |
| MANUAL | Needs human eyes: layout, fonts, printing, real devices | Run by hand |
| NEEDS_SPEC | Missing expected result, data or contract | Back to spec-review |

- Never use MANUAL to hide a spec gap.
- UI-AUTO means "eligible for automation", not "already automated" or "already run".
- Every TC must be runnable by hand before it has code.
~~~~

#### `.claude/skills/test-case/references/test-design-techniques.md`

~~~~markdown
| Technique | Use when | Coverage |
|---|---|---|
| EP — Equivalence partitioning | Input has valid / invalid groups | ≥ 1 TC per partition |
| BVA — Boundary value analysis | Min / max, length, thresholds | min-1, min, max, max+1 |
| Decision table | Several conditions combine into different results | ≥ 1 TC per rule |
| State transition | States + transitions | Every valid transition + important forbidden ones |
| Scenario / use flow | Multi-step business flow | Main flow + alternative flows |
| Role matrix | Permissions differ by role | Every role × action cell in the spec |
| Combination (pairwise) | Many independent parameters | Every pair of values appears ≥ 1 time |
| Error guessing | Errors known from experience | State the reason |
~~~~

#### `.claude/skills/test-viewpoint/SKILL.md`

~~~~markdown
---
name: test-viewpoint
description: Design Test Viewpoints in the Viewpoint sheet format (ID, Screen, Test Level/Test Type, Function, Test Viewpoint, Expected Result, Role, Site, Note). Each viewpoint is one test angle with a variation axis that produces several test cases, traced to the spec, then locked. Use when the user says "make viewpoints", "test angles", "/test-viewpoint".
---
# Input
- Approved <P>/spec/<scope-key>.md + LOCKED <P>/qc/gap-reports/<scope-key>-gap-report.md with Design Gate READY/PARTIAL and a Context pack.
- Knowledge + lessons (selective reading, grep by function / screen of the sheet, never whole folders):
  | Read | Why |
  |---|---|
  | Context pack (mandatory, read first) | Summary already filtered by spec-review |
  | qc/lessons/INDEX.md section Test design | Viewpoint rules that are often missed (group 8) |
  | <P>/bug-history.md — rows with the same function / pattern | Group 8 viewpoints; prioritise rows where "Caught by a TC" = No |
  | <P>/screens/ — related screens | Permission matrix, state transitions → role / status axes |
  | <P>/qc/test-viewpoints/ LOCKED files of the same function | No duplicates, nothing old missed |
  | <P>/glossary.md — only for unknown terms | Correct object names |
- New information not in the Context pack → add "Source: <file#section>" to the Note of the related VP.
- references/viewpoint-groups.md, qc/templates/viewpoint.md, qc/templates/data-test.md.

# What a viewpoint is (read carefully before writing)
- Viewpoint = 1 OBJECT × 1 ASPECT to verify, with 1 VARIATION AXIS. A test case = 1 value on that axis.
- 3 kinds of axis: data (data-test rows, input values) · state (status, data / no data, role) · combination of conditions.
- Test Viewpoint (English): "Verify that <object> <aspect> in case/when <GROUP of conditions>". The condition is a group, not a single value.

| Wrong (case by case) | Right (viewpoint) |
|---|---|
| Verify that an error is shown when '氏名' is blank | Verify that '氏名' is validated in case of invalid input (Note: Axis: data — D01–D14) |
| Verify that an error is shown when '氏名' exceeds 30 chars | (merged into the row above) |
| Verify that Submit is enabled at status 'Approved' | Verify that the submit button works correctly by record status (Note: Axis: status — Draft / Pending / Approved) |
| Verify that the Approve button is hidden for a Viewer | Verify that action buttons are displayed by role and status (Note: Axis: permission matrix — role × status) |

# Process
1. List the screens / functions in the spec, only for the requested sheet. One prefix per sheet (e.g. CHK).
2. Run every function through the 8 groups in viewpoint-groups.md; group 8 comes from the Context pack + qc/lessons/INDEX.md + bug-history (same function).
3. Inside each group, group by object (field / screen area / button / API / rule): each object × aspect = 1 VP. Each input field = exactly 1 validation VP, the data-test rows are its axis. Buttons by role → the axis is the permission matrix of the authoritative source.
4. One row per VP: ID = <PREFIX>-NN · Expected Result at a general level · Role, Site per spec · Note: "Axis: <kind> — <expected values>" + source (doc §section) / OQ.
5. Self-check before review — print a table ID | Axis | Expected TC count:
   - VP expected to have < 3 TCs → merge into a VP with the same object / aspect (exception: a rule with only one case — give the reason in Note).
   - Two VPs that differ only by one condition value → merge.
   - Every acceptance criterion has ≥ 1 VP; VPs contain no concrete steps or data.
6. Draft → review → write <P>/qc/test-viewpoints/<scope-key>-viewpoints.md per qc/templates/viewpoint.md → State = LOCKED when approved.

# Forbidden
- One VP per value / per condition (that is a test case) · splitting VPs per data-test row.
- Renaming / reordering columns · writing test cases at this step · translating Japanese text.
- Inventing functions / fields / messages outside the spec → write [to confirm] and create an OQ.
~~~~

#### `.claude/skills/test-viewpoint/references/viewpoint-groups.md`

~~~~markdown
Scan all 8 groups for every function, skip none:

| Group | Suggested Test Type | What to ask |
|---|---|---|
| 1. UI / Layout | UI | Matches the design, empty state, button / chip / badge states, responsive |
| 2. Positive | Function | The main flow works with valid data |
| 3. Negative | Validation | Wrong data, required fields blank, wrong order, no permission |
| 4. Boundary / Edge | Validation | Min / max length, min / max value, 0 / 1 / many / maximum, boundary dates |
| 5. Data / Business rule | Data | Data state, duplicates, relational constraints, calculations |
| 6. Cross-cutting | Transition / Security | Screen transitions, permission / role, Japanese messages, session / timeout, SQL injection, trim |
| 7. Performance | Performance | Screen / API response time, large data (lists of 1,000+ rows, export, large uploads), concurrent users, double submit. Set a threshold only when the spec gives a number; otherwise create an OQ asking for it |
| 8. Lessons / past bugs | Regression | From the Lesson / Bug rows of the Context pack (qc/lessons/INDEX.md D01–D19 + project bug-history). Any bug / lesson with the same function, field type or pattern → ≥ 1 VP; Note gives the bug ID or lesson file |

- Each group usually gives 1–a few VPs per function, NOT one VP per question in the "What to ask" column — those questions are values on the axis and become test cases.
- Each input field = 1 validation VP; the rows of qc/templates/data-test.md are its data axis.
- Test Viewpoint sentence (English): "Verify that <object> <aspect> in case/when <group of conditions>".
~~~~

### Templates

#### `automation/templates/screen.md`

~~~~markdown
# Screen template for automation (web, Playwright)
1 file = 1 screen: `<P>/automation/web/screens/<app>/<screen>.screen.ts`. The full screen description lives in `<P>/screens/catalog/` — only write the screen ID to look it up, never copy the description.

```ts
import { BaseScreen } from '../base.screen';

/**
 * <Screen name as shown in the UI> — catalog: <file>.md › "<section>"
 * Roles: <per permission matrix / catalog>. Wait: <API / landmark to wait for before asserting>.
 * Source: recon <date>, <env>. [to verify on the real app] <locators not verified yet>
 */
export class XxxScreen extends BaseScreen {
  readonly id = '<screen ID, e.g. SHP03>';
  readonly path = '<route>';
  readonly roles = ['standard'] as const;
  /** Landmark that proves THIS screen is rendered (R43) — not the URL. */
  readonly landmark = this.page.getByText('<exact page title>', { exact: true });

  // Locator priority: getByRole / getByLabel / getByText (UI label) → data-test / #id → CSS
  readonly saveButton = this.page.getByRole('button', { name: '保存' });

  async save(): Promise<void> { await this.saveButton.click(); }
}
```

Rules: locators only in screen files · no waitForTimeout · short actions, no asserts inside (except waitLoaded).
~~~~

### Lessons promoted to rules

#### `qc/lessons/INDEX.md`

~~~~markdown
# Learned rules — test design (the AI reads this at step 3 of the design flow)

## Test design (viewpoints / test cases that were missed)
- D01 Every submit / save button: add a case for double click / repeated Enter while loading → no duplicate records.
- D02 Amount / quantity fields: add boundaries MIN, MAX, 0 and negative numbers — not only typical values.
- D03 Uploads / chat / long text: add cases over the limit (characters, number of images, file size) that must show an error.
- D04 Two parties acting at the same time (one user submits while another completes…): add a race-condition case.
- D05 Status changes: check the old status is cleared and the new one is correct, including continue / redo flows.
- D06 Buttons by role: use the permission matrix of the basic design, never infer from similar-looking UI; test every role.
- D07 UI state must be kept / closed correctly: pagination after Back, dialog after save, read / unread, badges.
- D08 Data in the right context: never open / create data for another shop, record or user.
- D09 Happy path of push / notification / external integrations → always add a failure case; the business data must not be rolled back wrongly.
- D10 Same kind of impact → same assertions across TC groups; multi-step upgrades → test permissions at every intermediate step.
- D11 Before taking a ticket into scope: check the roles it covers, its release phase and its parent / child tickets.
- D12 Check duplicates by content (not only by ID) and trace VP ↔ TC both ways (no empty VP, no TC pointing to a missing VP).
- D13 Test the right layer: a security rule / middleware attached to a route is tested on that route, plus a negative case.
- D14 TCs imported from an outside file (hand-written CSV…): compare every step with the screen catalog / real screen and add mandatory steps that were skipped. (design/2026-10-12-e2e-missing-ui-step.md)
- D15 Master-edit screens with two save levels (row modal → page 'Save'): the TC must write both levels and check the data survives a reload. (design/2026-10-13-two-level-save.md)
- D16 Save followed by a completion dialog ("…が完了しました。" + 'OK'): Steps must say "Verify: dialog '<message>' → 'OK'" before the next step. (design/2026-10-13-save-done-dialog.md)
- D17 Flows taken from a CSV / the mobile app: compare with the web screens (catalog / recon) before LOCK; every condition branch (ON / OFF, category, below / above a limit…) gets its own steps and expected state, never one shared template when TCs are generated by script. (design/2026-10-14-e2e-branch-flow-template.md)
- D18 TCs driven by a record status / approval type: before LOCK inspect the real buttons at every status (Draft / Pending / Rejected / Withdrawn…), the status after each action and the full auto-approval conditions (tax included / excluded, per-level limits, urgent flag, several records); put each Verify at the role that can actually see it. (design/2026-10-16-status-actions-verified.md)
- D19 Forms with default rows / auto-computed cells (quotes, invoices…): Steps say whether default rows are kept or deleted, which cell gets which value and whether totals are tax included or excluded — never only "so that total = …". (design/2026-10-16-form-input-every-field.md)

## Excel / tools
- T01 Google Sheets tab names > 31 characters are renamed on xlsx export → INDIRECT formulas follow the new name.
- T02 FILTER / MAP / LAMBDA do not work in LibreOffice / openpyxl → existing #REF! / #NAME? are not caused by your edit.
- T03 The header row is not fixed → find the literal header (e.g. "TC ID"), never hard-code the row.
- T04 Merged cells → unmerge the target range before writing with openpyxl.
- T05 Text starting with "=" or "=+" is read as a formula → write it as text.
- T06 "Total TCs" at the top of a sheet = number of result cells (TC × role / platform), not the number of TCs.
- T07 Deliverables for reviewers: export a new file, never edit the original.
~~~~

#### `automation/lessons/INDEX.md`

~~~~markdown
# Learned rules — automation (the AI reads this before writing / fixing test code)

R01–R42 were learned on a production Japanese B2B web app (CMS with roles, wizards, approval flows); R43–R45 on the public demo (examples/demo-shop). Detailed write-ups exist for the rules that link a file; client-specific details were removed.

## Web
- R01 Screen never run before: get the real element tree (error-context.md / aria snapshot / codegen / recon) before writing locators; never write them from a CSV or the catalog alone. Wizards / role-dependent screens often have hidden steps. (web/2026-10-12-create-wizard-hidden-step.md)
- R02 Screenshot / snapshot hooks always have a timeout ≤ 10s and a .catch(); a self-created context (serial E2E) attaches its own screenshot + aria snapshot. (web/2026-10-12-afterEach-screenshot-hang.md)
- R03 Screens whose data loads after navigation (detail pages…): wait for one key data cell to have a value before checking / clicking; the right URL or networkidle is not enough. (web/2026-10-12-detail-async-load.md)
- R04 Check "label = value" on the cell right after the label (common helper), not the whole row; take the label text exactly as in the DOM (trailing ':' etc.).
- R05 Lists / tables / status badges that load later may first show '0件' or an old status → wait for a loaded marker ('全 N 件中', the right badge value, ~15s) before concluding. (web/2026-10-12-list-zero-before-load.md)
- R06 Labels inside th with an extra badge (必須 / 任意) or a wrapping span: match the label on the child text node, not the whole th.
- R07 The value of a native dropdown is checked with option:checked, not with the row text.
- R08 A modal × button with aria-label '閉じる' clashes with a text button '閉じる' → find the text button inside its own area; the × goes through a closeModal() helper.
- R09 Nested modals: filter a modal by text / elements only it has, not by its title text.
- R10 Toggle buttons (menu expand, accordion): check whether it is already open before clicking, then expect the new state.
- R11 Card grids with images: wait for images to load, click with dispatchEvent (not by coordinates), then CHECK the selected value; reselect if wrong.
- R12 Log says "intercepts pointer events" (popover / chat / overlay over the button): use dispatchEvent('click') + check the resulting state; never force:true. (web/2026-10-12-overlay-intercepts-click.md)
- R13 Serial scenario on one shared context: turn off automatic trace / video in the config, record the trace in chunks per TC; every hook command has a time limit. (web/2026-10-12-shared-context-trace-hang.md)
- R14 Data created for later TCs (record number, id…) is recorded IMMEDIATELY after creation, before any side action.
- R15 Nested modals that close by only removing a 'show' class (still in the DOM): check "closed" on the element you acted on (elementHandle) or exclude the parent by text only it has; never re-find with .last() filtered by text.
- R16 File uploads (S3) run asynchronously after 'Done' and the app ignores the next upload: wait for the upload response (PUT) to succeed before continuing; never waitForTimeout.
- R17 Result dialogs after a save (OK / 完了) appear when the server is done: wait with a long timeout (~30s), not the default 5s, never waitForTimeout.
- R18 After login / opening a page with a heavy API: wait for the real API response; slower than the env threshold (apiPerfLimitMs) → write a 'PERFORMANCE' warning to check later and continue. App dialogs caused by a slow environment ("表示に時間がかかっております"): only click OK + write an 'env-warning'; the code NEVER reloads / retries on its own (only when the TC says F5). (web/2026-10-13-heavy-api-after-login.md)
- R19 Slide-in drawers / panels sit off-screen when closed (inputs still "visible", buttons not clickable): check the open state (class 'show') before acting; the drawer's buttons may sit outside its inner form.
- R20 Pick a row / card by name: match the exact cell (td + exact), never hasText on the whole row — hasText matches substrings ('Test' ⊂ 'EnterTest'). (web/2026-10-13-hastext-substring.md)
- R21 Tables inside a form table: the outer tr also contains the inner rows → take the innermost tr (hasNot tr) or address the tbody by its own attribute.
- R22 An action may already have submitted the form (Enter, double click): wait for the form to close first; only if it is still open after a few seconds click submit — never an instant isVisible check then click. (web/2026-10-13-enter-submit-race.md)
- R23 Cards with thumbnail + caption: the clickable part is the role=button thumbnail, inspect it first; filter the preview modal by its own class, not by file name (the parent form contains the name too).
- R24 Serial scenarios: a TC that ends on an unsaved form gets a 'Cleanup' step (not part of the TC) that leaves the form, so the discard dialog does not block the next TC; never a global discard handler.
- R25 Cells the app computes / formats (unit price, totals…): wait until the app has finished computing (temporary '0' gone) before typing; after typing CHECK the value and the total again.
- R26 A full-page loader blocks clicks on large lists: wait for the loader to disappear (common/wait.ts waitForAppIdle) before acting.
- R27 After a search: wait for the response of THIS search (with its parameters) before reading the table — '全 N 件' / rows already on screen belong to the default list. (web/2026-10-13-search-stale-result.md)
- R28 Search boxes may auto-search after typing: wait a few seconds for the URL / response, click Search only if nothing happened; close a panel / drawer still open after searching before using the table.
- R29 Multi-step statuses (approval chains…): never assume the badge changes after each step; loop to the final status and check at the end.
- R30 Never use count() right after opening a screen / modal whose data loads async (count() does not wait): wait for the expected element first; count() = 0 must never be a reason to skip an action of the TC. (web/2026-10-14-count-before-async-load.md)
- R31 Wizards / screens with role-dependent steps: wait for "optional step OR next step", never a fixed number of steps; record the inspected roles in the screen file.
- R32 Read displayed codes / numbers with their full real format (e.g. '223470066_2' → `\d+(?:_\d+)?`) and assert the full value.
- R33 Ant Design select inside an iframe: open with repeated mousedown until options appear, filter the dropdown by the aria-controls of the right field, check .ant-select-selection-item after choosing.
- R34 The same modal reachable by several paths with role-dependent permissions (read-only in the header, editable through 'quick actions'): inspect the path that has the action buttons for each role; never assume two paths behave the same.
- R35 Sidebar menu names differ by role: call the menu by the role's own name, or open the URL directly when the TC does not test the menu.
- R36 Every spec in a suite must understand the dry-run flag (cannot dry-run → skip the whole file when DRY). Checks / recon always run DRY, real runs never DRY. (web/2026-10-15-dry-run-all-specs.md)
- R37 Waiting for API idle: a request hanging past the threshold is logged once as perf and dropped from the list; it must not block every later wait. (web/2026-10-16-api-stuck-request.md)
- R38 Modals whose data comes from their own API: wait for that response before checking the content; a visible modal ≠ data loaded.
- R39 Data attached to a record (assets, reports): inspect whether it is shown inline or in a modal; a modal opened for a check is closed within the same step (serial scenario).
- R40 Header buttons that exist only in some states (e.g. only while a submitted quote exists): check the state with a role that always sees it.
- R41 Records created by a test: take the id / code from the API response of the creating action itself (or the text the app shows right after creation); never "the newest row" of a list — someone else creating at the same time / old data gets picked. (web/2026-10-16-created-id-from-response.md)
- R42 Generated specs are changed only through the generator (bulk script edits included); after regenerating, review the git diff — any change outside the template you touched → stop and move it into the generator first. (web/2026-10-16-generated-spec-hand-edit-lost.md)
- R43 SPA navigation: the URL changes before the new page renders — after a click that navigates, wait for the target page's landmark (page title / unique heading), not waitForURL; screen objects expose waitLoaded() for this. (web/2026-10-26-spa-url-before-render.md)
- R44 A TC fails because of a known product bug: keep the expect exactly as the TC says and mark the test as an expected failure with the bug ID from bug-history (the generator does it from the BUG-… in the TC Function); when the bug is fixed the test turns red and the mark is removed. (web/2026-10-26-known-bug-expected-failure.md)

- R45 Cards whose image / title are links with role=button: getByRole('button') inside the card is not unique — target the action by its name, or by the native <button> element when its text toggles. (web/2026-10-26-card-links-role-button.md)

## Mobile
~~~~

~~~~markdown
# Decisions — newest first
<!-- One decision per row. Read by humans who need to know "why"; the AI does not read this file during normal tasks. -->
~~~~

## Appendix B — Recent changes

# Changelog

## [Unreleased]

## [1.0.0] - 2026-10-26
### Added
- Public release of the framework (D29): CLAUDE.md, 7 skills, QC templates, 19 test-design rules + 7 Excel rules, 45 automation rules with 18 detailed lessons.
- examples/demo-shop: full pipeline on a public practice shop — spec, messages, Gap Report (DONE, 5 OQs), 10 viewpoints, 37 test cases (LOCKED), generated Playwright spec (35 automated TCs, 2 known bugs as expected failures).
- Generic TC → spec generator (scripts/gen-specs.mjs + step-patterns.mjs) with `--check`, TC revision guard, message check against spec/messages.md, known-bug marking from bug-history.md.
- Automation lessons from the demo: R43 (SPA URL before render), R44 (known bug → expected failure), R45 (role=button links inside cards).
- CI: type check, generator drift check, GUIDE.md check, public-safety scan, demo suite.
- scripts/check-before-push.sh: scans tracked files and history for secrets, client words (local list) and large files.

### Changed
- Every rule, skill and template translated to English; client names, screens, URLs and accounts removed.

## [0.x] - 2026-10-09 … 2026-10-16
- Private production use on a Japanese B2B web app: 562 E2E test cases in 38 scenarios, 36 specs generated from test cases, 42 automation rules and 19 test-design rules learned (history not published).
